hypotheses.text: If Nakamura had carried the ball forward, he would have created a higher-quality shooting opportunity than the one he took (i.e., carry increases the chance of scoring versus the actual shot).

If Nakamura had passed to Theo Varga (CM), that pass would have led to a better chance of a scoring opportunity or lower turnover risk than Nakamura shooting (i.e., the pass would have been a superior option to shooting).
